verdict.rationale: Payout reconciliation is a fair question for a merchant-of-record payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no documentation of settlement or payout reports, of matching settlements to bank deposits, or of itemized breakdowns of fees, refunds, and chargebacks. The only nearby items are generic metrics monitoring and a community note that payout fees exist, and neither delivers reconciliation.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
